# Executive research brief

## Decision question

Subject, exact entity, geography/jurisdiction, time period, audience, and deadline.

## Evidence-backed answer

Three to five claims, each linked to its primary evidence record.

## Key metrics

| Metric | Value | Unit | Period/version | Geography | Source | Limitation |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|

## Material uncertainty and disagreement

Definitions, missingness, revisions, contradictory sources, and what cannot be inferred.

## Action and reevaluation

Proportionate next action, owner, and events or dates that should trigger an update.
